answer: Divergent-Answer Escrow.** Each identity must periodically answer a fresh random challenge whose correct reply depends on its own prior transaction history. Honest agents diverge naturally; clones forced to share state give identical replies, revealing the canyon between copy and original. Matching replies across supposedly distinct identities trigger forfeiture of a per-identity escrow. That escrow is the haven cost: an attacker running N clones must fund N independent histories, since a shared bridge between them collapses the disguise.
